product.summary: Zerion self-custody mobile wallet for multichain Web3 asset management and dApp access on iOS and Android.
product.notes: The 2022-05-26 launch establishes the mobile wallet lineage. Zerion's later browser extension has its own 2023 release lifecycle and is intentionally not collapsed into this mobile product.

events.title: Zerion Wallet added TRON support
events.description: Zerion announced on 2026-01-08 that TRON was live in Zerion Wallet, enabling users to buy TRX and TRC-20 USDT and send or store TRON assets alongside the wallet other supported chains.

evidence.title: Install Zerion
evidence.notes: Current first-party installation guide separately documents the Zerion mobile app for iOS/Android and Zerion browser extension, supporting WLR's decision to keep the mobile product boundary separate.

evidence.title: Download Zerion
evidence.notes: The first-party Zerion download page currently offers the mobile wallet on iOS and Android. This supports current mobile availability review without inferring launch timing.

evidence.title: Zerion Wallet Integrates TRON to Support the Mass Adoption of Stablecoin Payments
evidence.notes: First-party Zerion announcement states TRON is live in Zerion Wallet.
